overview: This enum controls how an effect finds the ground row that supplies its ground attributes.

None.simple: The effect does not request ground checking on its own.
None.technical: This is the constructor default. Initialization enables the per-tick ground attribute only for Possessor and Own, so a None row leaves that update off by default. If another caller enables it, UpdateGroundAttribute takes the non-Own branch and uses SourceInterface368.GetCurrentMapGroundRow, then writes GroundAttribute and IsGround to each Niagara component.

Possessor.simple: The effect checks the ground under the fighter who owns it.
Possessor.technical: Initialization turns on the ground attribute for this value. UpdateGroundAttribute takes the non-Own branch and calls SourceInterface368.GetCurrentMapGroundRow. It copies that row's EffectAttribute into the GroundAttribute Niagara parameter and sets IsGround from whether a row was found.

Own.simple: The effect checks the ground at its own location.
Own.technical: Initialization turns on the ground attribute for this value. UpdateGroundAttribute calls SourceInterface368.GetMapGroundRow with the effect's current location and the row's GroundCheckDistance. The returned row supplies the GroundAttribute Niagara parameter, and a missing row sets IsGround to zero.

Invalid.simple: This value marks an invalid ground-check target.
Invalid.technical: The enum declares it with value 255. No exported EffectDataTable row uses it and no named consumer reads it, so its ground behavior is unknown.

notes: The byte at effect row offset 0x49 decides whether initialization enables the ground attribute and which ground lookup the per-tick update uses.
Possessor and None both take the non-Own branch, which uses the source actor's current ground row.
GroundCheckDistance is read only by the Own branch.
External callers can enable the ground attribute independently of this byte, so a None effect can still run UpdateGroundAttribute.
No exported EffectDataTable row uses Possessor or Invalid. Two exported rows use Own.
